thinks-true.statement: v13 POSITIVE FINDING: at every confirmed period-doubling diagonal D ∈ {3, 8, 29, 400}, TAX is CONSERVED (|defect| = 0), not violated. The reason is structural: the law H08 requires (with odd parity of D-2) the (D-1) pattern to be eventually white (w(D-1) = 0). When w(D-1) = 0, TAX conservation trivially holds because w(D-1 AND D) = 0 and w(D-1 XOR D) = w(D), so the quadratic identity reduces to 0 + w(D)^2 - 0 - w(D)^2 = 0. The white (D-1) pattern is the COMMON CAUSE of both the period doubling (it forces a reset in the one-bit machine) AND the TAX conservation (it makes the AND vanish). The previous round's hypothesis ('TAX breaks at jumps') had the causal arrow reversed: TAX does not break at jumps; TAX is CONSERVED at jumps, because the same white pattern that forces the period to double also forces TAX to be conserved. This is the v13 discovery.
thinks-true.evidence: status=law-holds; survives held-out but not formally verified
